adjudication_summary: Worker-2 repaired the activity/toxicity table extraction, worker-4 reconciled linked database rows with conflict preservation, and worker-6 accepted the paper as publication-grade with explicit cautions rather than clean acceptance.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The methods/results prose identify MR S. aureus ATCC 33591 for biofilm testing, while Table 4 caption states ATCC 33951. Table 4 row targets preserve the caption, and MBEC prose rows preserve the prose target.

DBAASP/DRAMP provide exact hemolysis and HEK293 curve values; primary text gives thresholds and IC50, while Figure 2/3 are plotted images rather than numeric source tables. Exact figure-digitized values remain database cautions, not source_verified table values.

DRAMP aggregate rows repeat source-supported sequence/MIC claims but omit some Table 3 targets and include exact figure-derived toxicity values; CAMP reverses the hemolysis threshold sign. These rows are preserved as source_conflict with locators.

The OA package contains article XML/PDF/figures and the landed supplementary directory contains HTML/page-image assets, not a separate XLSX/PDF data supplement that changes activity or database adjudication.
Mechanism statements are limited to physicochemical inference, antibiofilm phenotype, and author hypothesis; exact molecular mechanisms of B1 and combinations were not directly assayed.

materials_exhausted.note: Paper-local XML/PDF/OA figures/database snapshots and landed supplementary assets were opened; no separate source needed for the repaired owner layers remains unexamined.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: B1 sequence and synthesis are source-verified from Table 1 and peptide synthesis text; MIC/IC50 rows are source-verified where exact primary-source evidence exists; aggregate/digitized database rows are preserved as source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 3 MIC/MBC, Table 4 antibiofilm viability/MBEC/MBECb, Table 5 checkerboard FIC rows, hemolysis thresholds, and HEK293 IC50 are source-backed with units and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism layer is accepted only with bounded interpretation: phenotype and indirect rationale are source-backed, while direct molecular mechanism remains unclaimed.
